tests.details: Parsed FoundationFieldbusLasSync and alias with 10 registered bindings: ['%M331', '%M332', '%R1420', '%R1421', '%R1422', '%R1423', '%R1424', '%R1425', '%R1426', '%R1427'].
Validated DLPDU token encoding/decoding, CRC-16 FCS calculation, and PT/CD/PN/TD dispatch.
100ms macrocycle executed cleanly with 12 active devices and 24 scheduled function blocks.
Verified execution of AI, AO, PID, DI, DO, Transducer Block, and Resource Block.
Validated FF-891 8-bit status octet encoding, quality bitmasks, substatus, and limit clamps.
Macrocycle schedule overrun (>200ms) asserted 0xCE01, tripped %M332, cleared %M331, and incremented %R1424.
Nominal latency scaled 120 (12.0 ms); bus jitter > 5000 us tripped 0xCE02 safety interlock.
Slave dropout (0xCE03) and Function Block BAD execution fault (0xCE04) trapped deterministically.
ILogicUnit scan execution, operator reset handshake, and Horner OCS register synchronization verified.
